objective: Project canonical quoted and bound acquisition outcome facts into distinct relationship numerators over an explicit relationship cohort without persistence, rate rounding, or lifecycle inference.
rules: The caller supplies the explicit denominator cohort as relationshipIds.
Relationship IDs are canonically validated and deduplicated.
Every outcome fact is revalidated through the canonical INS-003R outcome contract.
Every outcome fact must belong to the explicit cohort.
Multiple quoted facts for one relationship count as one quoted relationship.
Multiple bound facts for one relationship count as one bound relationship.
A bound outcome does not implicitly count as quoted unless a quoted outcome fact also exists.
Lost, declined, requested, in-progress, and written are not inferred as quoted or bound outcomes.
The projection is pure and performs no persistence reads or writes.
No percentages, rates, or cost-per-outcome values are calculated in this slice.
